user.title: Set up Blue Iris
user.description: Set up your BlueIris Server details (to control profiles, fill in valid username and password)

features.title: Blue Iris features
features.description: Pick the features to set up. Cameras, sensors per camera and the rest are set in Configure afterwards.

server.name: Server sensors
server.description: Blue Iris server status shown on the server device.

auto_reset.name: Auto reset defaults
auto_reset.description: Used by every camera that has not been changed on its own device page. Changing a camera's Auto Reset entities overrides these for that camera.

error.already_configured: BlueIris integration already configured with the name

blue_iris_additional_settings.title: Blue Iris options
blue_iris_additional_settings.description: Pick which components to create. **All** includes cameras added to Blue Iris later, **None** turns the section off, **Choose…** opens a checkbox list on the next page.

data_description.allowed_problem_sensor: Cameras on battery or solar power, or that only stream when motion is detected, may need Problem Detection turned off: use the Problem Detection switch on that camera's device page (Configuration). It stops the Problem sensor and auto reset for that camera only, so this section can stay on All. Also turn off that camera's Watchdog in Blue Iris.

camera_controls.name: Camera controls
camera_controls.description: Admin user. Per camera, on its device page.

data_description.allowed_camera_snapshot: Saves a snapshot into Blue Iris' own clips database (timeline, UI3), not a file in Home Assistant.
data_description.allowed_camera_motion: Off by default. Turns motion detection on or off for the camera's active profile; read from Blue Iris every 5 minutes.
data_description.allowed_camera_reboot: Off by default. Reboots the camera itself; only works on cameras that support reboot through Blue Iris.

mqtt_sensors.name: MQTT sensors
mqtt_sensors.description: Shown when the MQTT integration is set up.

server.name: Server sensors
server.description: Blue Iris server status shown on the server device.

connection.name: Connection
connection.description: Server and login. A username and password with admin rights are needed for profiles, schedules and Reset Camera.

data_description.log_level: Applied every time Home Assistant starts or the integration reloads. Change it live, until the next restart, with the server's Log Level entity. Default keeps Home Assistant's own logging setup.

auto_reset.name: Auto reset defaults
auto_reset.description: Used by every camera that has not been changed on its own device page. Changing a camera's Auto Reset entities overrides these for that camera.

data.auto_reset_apply_defaults: Set all cameras back to these defaults

data_description.auto_reset_apply_defaults: Clears every camera's own auto reset values. Not saved; runs once when you submit.
data_description.auto_reset_notifications: One notification per camera with the problem and the outcome of the resets. Same as the server's Auto Reset Notifications switch.

select_items.title: Choose components
select_items.description: Tick the items to create in each section.

allowed_problem_sensor.name: Problem sensors
allowed_problem_sensor.description: Cameras on battery or solar power, or that only stream when motion is detected, may need Problem Detection turned off: use the Problem Detection switch on that camera's device page (Configuration). It stops the Problem sensor and auto reset for that camera only, so this section can stay on All. Also turn off that camera's Watchdog in Blue Iris.
